title: RDP Connection
description: Schema describing an RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) connection profile, modeled after common RDP file (.rdp) configuration parameters.

name.description: Friendly name for this connection profile.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the RDP server to connect to.

port.description: Network port for the RDP service. Defaults to 3389.

username.description: Username used to authenticate with the RDP host.

domain.description: Active Directory domain (or workgroup) for the user account.

screenWidth.description: Desktop width in pixels for the remote session.

screenHeight.description: Desktop height in pixels for the remote session.

colorDepth.description: Session color depth in bits per pixel.

fullScreen.description: Whether to launch the session in full screen mode.

audioMode.description: Where to play remote audio: on the local client, on the remote host, or disabled.

redirectClipboard.description: Whether to share the local clipboard with the remote session.

redirectPrinters.description: Whether to redirect local printers to the remote session.

redirectDrives.description: Whether to redirect local drives to the remote session.

redirectSmartcards.description: Whether to redirect local smart card devices to the remote session.

useGateway.description: Whether to connect through an RD Gateway server.

gatewayHostname.description: Hostname of the RD Gateway when useGateway is true.

networkLevelAuthentication.description: Whether to require Network Level Authentication (NLA) before the session is established.
